description: Source code for HomeFragment class in an Android TV app, managing the main home screen with sections like banners, categories, and content rows, including mock data generation.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the Android TV home screen with sections, banners, and navigation.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data class representing a media content item with id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row of content with a title and list of ContentItems.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: Object providing mock data generation for ContentItems.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the sections list after view creation.

methods.name: setupSectionsList
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView with sections, banners, categories, and mock data.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up view binding when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a list of mock ContentItem objects.
